purpose: Historical breaking changes replayed against public repositories that were really affected: for each, the commit before the maintainers changed the code by hand (before) and that change (fix). Chosen from commit search and frozen-list histories before any Refit run on them.

changes.summary: Stripe API 2025-03-31.basil moved current_period_start and current_period_end from the Subscription to each subscription item.
changes.source: stripe/openapi tag v1642 (spec3.json info.version 2025-03-31.basil), pinned in docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-stripe-fresh-repos.json

search.method: Frozen Stripe lists (597 repositories, 2026-10-14 to 2026-10-16): checkouts whose code reads items.data[0].current_period_end, then the oldest commit in each history that added that read (git log -G), kept when the same commit removed the old read and changed the API version or stripe-node.

changes.summary: Stripe API 2026-09-30.endive removed payment_method_types from Checkout Session, PaymentIntent and SetupIntent creation; allowed_payment_method_types replaces it.
changes.source: stripe/openapi tag v2526 (spec3.json info.version 2026-09-30.endive), pinned in docs/benchmarks/2026-10-16-stripe-fresh-repos.json

changes.summary: Anthropic retired claude-sonnet-4-20250514 on the Claude API.
changes.source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/model-deprecations (read 2026-10-22: "2026-04-14: Claude Sonnet 4 and Claude Opus 4 models", retirement June 15, 2026); registry entry anthropic-2026-06-15-claude-sonnet-4

changes.summary: OpenAI shut down the legacy GPT-4 snapshots, including gpt-4-0125-preview and gpt-4-turbo-preview, which points to it.
changes.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations (read 2026-10-22: "2025-09-26: Legacy GPT model snapshots (March 2026 shutdown)", shutdown 2026-03-26); registry entry openai-2026-03-26-gpt-4-0314

changes.summary: Shopify stopped serving Admin API 2025-01; requests to it fall forward to the oldest accessible stable version.
changes.source: https://shopify.dev/docs/api/usage/versioning (read 2026-10-22): no longer lists 2025-01; each stable version is supported for a minimum of 12 months, so 2025-01 was accessible at least until 2026-01-01. The exact date is not on the page, and the registry has no entry for 2025-01 (it starts at 2025-04).

notReplayed.why: No repository found with code that read charges on an API version before 2022-11-15 and a later hand fix. The 27 frozen-list repositories whose code reads latest_charge never read charges in their own history (git log -G), and commit search ("latest_charge 2022-11-15", "stripe charges.data latest_charge") reaches back only weeks. Four commit-search hits that move charges reads to latest_charge are a latent read on a version that never had charges (antikkorps/scs-fa, stripe-node 20 with no pin), an unexpanded latest_charge (launchflowuk-sys/PizzaParty), or not JavaScript or TypeScript.
